title: Unbearable
html:
Grumbo, a gentle ogre on the Ogre Isle beach, loved the island's bears. His kin hunted them to the last and smoked the meat, which is why ogres carry cooked bear in their belts.

About

Given byGrumbo
Level38
LengthMedium
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

  • Cooked Bear Meat ×3

Steps

  1. Talk to Grumbo (outdoors near Plymouth Wharf) to get the quest.
  2. Kill 15 ogres on Ogre Isle, and bring Grumbo 3 Cooked Bear Meat (bears drop bear meat; cook it at a fire).
  3. Ask Gerald Seabroden about bears.
  4. Tell Grumbo the news to finish the quest.

Rewards

Reward
Gold9,980
Character XP312,000
Quest points1

What Grumbo says

Grumbo: You found them. Oh. They're smaller than Grumbo remembers.

Grumbo: This one is Bessie. She liked honey, and sitting on logs until the logs broke.

Grumbo: This one is Big Tom. He wasn't big. It was a joke name. Everybody laughed, Tom most of all.

Grumbo: Grumbo doesn't know this one. But Grumbo is sure it was a good bear.

Grumbo: Goodbye, bears. You were very round and very good.

Grumbo: Grumbo has one more question, and it's a scary one. Are there any bears left anywhere? The boat man at the dock goes over the water. Ask him. Grumbo can't. What if he says no?

Gerald Seabroden: Bears? The big fellow by the wreck sent you, didn't he? He's been staring at my boat all week.

Gerald Seabroden: Tell him yes. The woods around Underleaf are full of them. Linnet Birch up there thinks there are too many.

Gerald Seabroden: And tell him I'll row him across for nothing, as long as he sits still. I've seen him sit down. The whole dock moved.

Grumbo: Lots of bears? Too many bears? There is no such thing as too many bears.

Grumbo: Grumbo is going to Underleaf. Grumbo will sit very still in the woods and let the bears come to him. Grumbo is good at sitting.

Grumbo: And Grumbo is never eating meat again. Only fish. Fish don't have ears. Grumbo checked.

Grumbo: Take this. It's all the shiny things Grumbo found in the sand. Grumbo doesn't need shiny things. Grumbo needs bears.

Handing it in

"Take this. It's all the shiny things Grumbo found in the sand. Grumbo doesn't need shiny things. Grumbo needs bears."
